repositories.name: Troika Three Text
repositories.purpose: Dynamic SDF typography inside Three.js scenes

licence.restrictions: Retain copyright and permission notices; separate font and asset licences require review.

requirements: Permitted font origins and worker/CSP behavior
Explicit asynchronous result and resource ownership
repositories.api_mcp: Frontend JavaScript API; no MCP/server/account required for reviewed use

costs.notes: No new paid service used; font bandwidth, glyph generation and atlas memory unmeasured.

repositories.decision: Evaluate in an isolated authorized fixture, not production adoption.
risks: No-change sync callback is not called
Completion events can precede a queued newer result
Geometry disposal is not material ownership or async cancellation
